At line 2: `String name = mapper.map(zipEntry.getName());`
At line 18: `File tmp0 = file.getParentFile();`

The variable `tmp0` is assigned the parent directory of `file` at line 18. The `file` variable is created at line 4: `File file = new File(outputDir, name);`

So `file` is constructed using `name` (line 4), and `tmp0` is the parent of `file` (line 18). This means `tmp0` indirectly depends on `name` because `tmp0` is derived from `file`, which is constructed using `name`.
